title: Keto Lentil Wrap
description: A tasty and healthy keto wrap made with lentils and syrian ingredients. This meal is perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: 1. Cook the jubilant lentils according to package instructions.
2. In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
3. Add the cooked lentils to the pan and stir in the lentil seasoning.
4. Warm the syrian wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
5. Spoon the lentil mixture onto the center of the warmed wrap.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
7. Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
